definition: Repaying a loan with equal regular payments, each covering that period's interest with the rest reducing the amount owed, so the debt reaches 0 with the last payment; in IB exams the payments are made at the end of each period.

A lump sum invested now that pays out a fixed amount each period for a set number of periods, while the money left in it keeps earning compound interest; in IB exams the payments are made at the end of each period.
